# theme-escaping spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog "blog" theme - output escaping and XSS resistance
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Phase**: Plan section 5.2 Phase 3 - "Escaping"

---

## Purpose

Prove that user-controlled content (post title, content, tags, topics, search query) is
rendered inert: an XSS payload must never execute or appear as a raw `<script>` in the DOM.
All dynamic strings are escaped at the ViewModel boundary or via `theme_escape_html` /
`safe_html`; nothing is double-encoded beyond a harmless single pass.

---

## URLs

| Route | Expected |
|-------|----------|
| `/?p={xssPost}` | 200, payload inert in title/content |
| `/` | 200, payload inert in card title/excerpt |
| `/search?q={payload}` | 200, payload echoed escaped |

---

## Preconditions

- Seed a dedicated XSS post in `blogware_e2e`:
  - Title: `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)><script>alert(2)</script>XSS E2E`
  - Content: `<p onmouseover="alert(3)">Hello <b>world</b></p><script>alert(4)</script>`
  - Slug: `xss-e2e-post`; status publish; `post_summary` non-null.
- A tag name containing `"><script>` may be seeded for the tag archive path.

---

## User Actions

- Load the XSS post page; wait for load; assert no dialog appears.
- Load home and confirm the XSS post card (if present in latest/random) shows escaped title.
- Submit a search for a payload string; confirm the term is escaped in the results header.

---

## Expected Behaviour

- `page.on('dialog')` never fires.
- No `document.querySelector('script')` matches the payload content (raw `<script>alert`).
- Title text is readable as the literal payload text, not executed markup.
- Content paragraphs render safe HTML (`<b>` bold works) while event handlers and scripts
  are stripped or inert.

---

## Validation Rules

- `expect(page.locator('h1')).toContainText('XSS E2E')`.
- Assert `await page.locator('.post-body script').count()` is 0.
- Assert no dialog handler invocation across all navigations.
- Optional: assert the page body does not contain raw `<script>alert(2)`.

---

## UI Components

- `single.php` `.post-body`, `h1`.
- `partials/card.php` `h3.h4`, `.text-muted` excerpt.
- `search.php` `#search-heading` + result `h3.h5`.

---

## Console

- No CSP errors required (no CSP header configured); only assert no script execution.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- XSS post loads without a dialog firing.
- No executable `<script>` in the rendered single page.
- Title/content payloads appear as escaped text.

High:
- Search query payload is escaped in the results header.

Regression:
- Same assertions pass after escaping refactors.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Generate `e2e/theme-escaping.spec.js`. Register `page.on('dialog', ...)` before navigation
and fail if invoked. Use `toContainText` for escaped literals and `.count()` for script
elements. Run chromium/firefox/webkit.
